limitations.message: Single active Project; all twelve typed draft objects share atomic edits, session history and actual save/Open tasks. Stable-ID array scalar leaves are supported, array structure changes require UI. Runs use the actual Engine with frozen project/scenario/module versions. Definition cycle samples are session-only and require explicitly mapped executable definitions; other task controls are not implemented. Native transport authenticates peers before registering Host sessions; category labels do not establish complete provider acceptance.
